China’s premier chipmaker, CXMT, reported an impressive 873.64% year-on-year revenue increase for the first half of 2026. The Hefei-based company, known for its dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) products, revealed a revenue of 150.31 billion yuan ($22.4 billion) for the six months ending June.
